introspection.json in this directory is a VERBATIM copy. Do not edit it here.

  original: meta/fixtures/introspection.json
            (V-M-Pioneer-Trading/meta, repo root `fixtures/introspection.json`)
  meta commit: 53b2cd8cc1007c62d22a3abe7970bf7e16d8814f (2026-09-21, fixture version 2)
  sha256: e605f62b820129068acbaef5d67af9b49df9fcf2247d0319ec4f9196338ea3a8

The sha256 above is the hash of the LF bytes of introspection.json and is
asserted by conformance_test.go, so the pin enforces itself instead of relying
on someone remembering to re-copy. The repository's .gitattributes marks that
one file `-text` so a Windows checkout (core.autocrlf=true) keeps the same
bytes a Linux checkout has and the hash holds on both.

The provenance lives in this sibling file rather than as a key inside the JSON
so the copy stays byte-identical to the original and `diff` is the drift check.
Change meta first, then re-copy and update the commit and the sha256 above.

agent-service is a CALLING SERVICE. All 35 `cases` bind it and are driven by
conformance_test.go against a real HTTP stub of the center. The 10
`gatewayCases` are st-gateway's lane policy, which this service does not
implement; the test skips them by name and asserts there are exactly 10, so a
gateway case added in meta is noticed here too.
